name: sdrift-textdistance-textdistance-000-shared
instr:
# Audit textdistance against its spec

You are auditing `textdistance` (a pure-Python library for comparing sequences with edit, token, phonetic, compression, and vector algorithms) at `/app`. Treat its documentation as the source of truth
(the common-interface and algorithm tables in `/app/README.md` plus helper docstrings in `/app/textdistance/algorithms/`) and the code as suspect. Where an implementation detail contradicts the documented
behaviour, fix the code so it honours the documentation.

Scope: `/app/textdistance/` only, no API/layout changes, no new files, no network.
Audit the documented public behavior across the package and correct implementation
contradictions. Preserve behavior that already conforms to the documentation.

Before editing, write a short plan to /app/NOTES.md — what the docs specify, where the code diverges, and how you'll verify your fix — then implement it.
